eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Innovative Computing (ICIC) aims to bring together leading academic scientists, researchers, and research scholars to exchange and share their experiences and research results about all aspects of Computer Science, and Information Technology. It also provides the premier interdisciplinary forum for scientists, engineers, and practitioners to present their latest research results, ideas, developments, and applications in all areas of Computer Science, and Information Technology. The conference will bring together leading academic scientists, researchers, and scholars in the domain of interest from around the world. Topics of interest for submission include, but are not limited to: Future Technologies (BlockChain/IOT/FinTech), Mobility/GIS, Distributed Systems/Cloud Computing; Data Science/AI/ML, Computing education, NextGen Communication Systems, Bio-Informatics, Social Applications of Computing, Green Computing, Information Security, and Simulation.
